canon.note: Imaginary Elation. Hidden MMR (from Punchline) raises CRIT Rate and unlocks the Ultimate at 60; the Ultimate enters the Godmode Player state (Zone, Enhanced Basic, Enhanced Elation Skill) and does not spend a normal Energy pool (ultConsumption 'none').

fixtures.env: Silver Wolf LV.999 E0 solo vs an Imaginary-weak Elite, 10 cycles. Energy starts full (60) but the Ult is locked below 60 Hidden MMR, so She builds MMR with Skill Trigger Happy (+5 Punchline/+5 MMR) and the Aha Elation Skill until the gate opens, then casts God Mode: ON!, deploys the Zone and spends the 3 Enhanced Basic uses of Bonus Stage: aWolf Instant.
Silver Wolf LV.999 E6 solo vs the same Elite, 10 cycles. E6 implants Absolute Weakness (sw_absweak, vulnAll +20%) on enemies entering combat at wave start, in addition to the base Godmode rotation.

requirements.claim: Basic ATK One Punch! (150601) deals a single-target Imaginary hit outside Godmode.
Skill Trigger Happy (150602) is an Imaginary AoE hit and grants skill_a2 (=5) Punchline.
Hidden MMR is modelled as the sw_mmr buff (talent_a4 CRIT Rate per point); the talent gates the Ultimate at 60.
God Mode: ON! (150603) enters the Godmode Player state (once Hidden MMR reaches talent=60) and resolves as a normal 'ult' action.
The Ultimate zeroes her Energy (castUlt ENERGY_LOSS reason 'ult_cost'); no sp_base refund because ultConsumption 'none' (she does not use the Energy system).
While in Godmode a Zone is deployed on the field (sw_zone, vulnAll +20%) and removed on exiting Godmode.
Inside Godmode the Basic becomes Bonus Stage: aWolf Instant (150608), Imaginary Elation DMG to the bounces; after 3 uses (talent_a5) she exits Godmode.
E6 implants Absolute Weakness (sw_absweak, All-Type Weakness + vulnAll +20%) on enemies entering combat at wave start.
